title: WHIP session liveness depends only on DTLS state, so an abrupt OBS loss or a never-completed ICE leaves the session 'connected' indefinitely
test: tests/whipRoutes.test.js (node:test mock timers): "ICE disconnecting while DTLS stays connected starts the grace period, and the grace timer then closes the session", "ICE returning to 'connected' within the grace period cancels the teardown and restores the connected state", "ICE returning to 'completed' within the grace period cancels the teardown and restores the connected state", "a second ICE outage after a recovery starts a new grace period", "ICE disconnecting while produce() is pending still lets the session go live, but disconnected until ICE returns", "a WHIP session whose DTLS never connects after the 201 is closed when the establishment timeout expires", "DTLS connecting stops the establishment timer, so a session that went live is not closed by it", "the establishment timer does not outlive the session: closeWhipSession and the OBS DELETE clear it", "a replaced session's grace timer never closes the session that replaced it", "ICE flapping before DTLS connects leaves no grace period or reconnecting flag behind once ICE is back"; regression guards that pass before and after: "ICE recovery does not undo a DTLS failure: the grace period still closes the session", "a replaced session's establishment timer never closes the session that replaced it"
proof: The tests run the real WHIP router on a real HTTP server with fake mediasoup transports (the harness of TASK-036; the fake's close() now also drops its icestatechange listeners, as mediasoup delivers no events after close) and node:test mock timers for setTimeout. With the unchanged lib files, 10 of the 29 tests in the file failed: after transport.emit('icestatechange', 'disconnected') on a live session nothing happened (room.whipConnected stayed true, 'true !== false'; whipReconnecting stayed false, no grace timer, no host metrics), and after the grace timeout the transport was still open ('the transport is closed': false !== true), so a transport whose ICE consent expired without a DTLS close_notify stayed 'connected' forever; ICE recovery tests failed on the same first assertion; after a 201 with no DTLS there was no timer (room.whipEstablishTimer undefined, 'the timer runs once the 201 is out') and the session, resource and transport stayed forever; a replaced session's ICE grace period was never started, so the replacement test could not even set it up. After the fix: beginGracePeriod(reason) is the former DTLS-failed branch extracted, guarded by isCurrentSession() (generation and transport), now also started by 'icestatechange' 'disconnected'; on 'connected'/'completed' endGracePeriod() clears the grace timer, resets whipReconnecting, restores whipConnected=true if the session had gone live and emits host metrics, unless DTLS is failed/closed (that cannot recover; the grace timer still closes it, which a guard test pins). A session that finished its producers while ICE was already down is committed but left disconnected (whipConnected = iceState !== 'disconnected'). startEstablishTimer() runs when the 201 is about to be sent: room.whipEstablishTimer, WHIP_GRACE_TIMEOUT_MS (Q-005 default: no dedicated config key exists, so none was added), unref'd; DTLS 'connected' clears it, closeWhipSession clears it (also the fallback closer in lib/roomLifecycle.js), and on expiry teardownGeneration('ICE/DTLS establishment timed out') runs only if the generation is still current and DTLS never connected: relay stopped, closeWhipSession (producers, transport, resource), fallbackAvailable false, host told. Superseded-generation timers: closeWhipSession clears both timers and both callbacks check isCurrentSession(); the two replacement tests show a replacement session that went live survives ticks past both deadlines. Not tested directly: an icestatechange delivered by a superseded transport (VAL-050 last sentence): mediasoup 3.27.1 delivers no events for a closed transport, as noted for DTLS in TASK-036, so the isCurrentSession() guard in the handler is a safeguard. node --test tests/whipRoutes.test.js 29/29; tests/config.test.js 16/16; npm test 1263/1263; lint and typecheck pass.
